import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Extract the top 10 most common breeds
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index

# Filter the data for these top breeds
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Count the number of dogs per year for each of the top breeds
breed_counts = filtered_data.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='counts')

# Plot the data
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
sns.lineplot(data=breed_counts, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='counts', hue='Rasse1Text', marker='o')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per Year in Zurich (Top 10 Breeds)')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.legend(title='Breed')
plt.grid(True)
plt.xticks(breed_counts['StichtagDatJahr'].unique())

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
